# P37.24 — Overview builder A and /graphs/**

Spec: `docs/tickets/448_P37.24__overview-builder-a.md` · Round-11 plan row 448 · `R11-K13-GX-08a` (= K2 GX-08a) · kind: ticket · live stage: none · OM-14: none.
Harness: devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · Base: `r11/P37.23-entity-pages-b`.

## What lands

The first wave of K2 GX-08a's per-release overview graphs — the export builder plus its static T1 surface:

- **`exports.graph_overview` (`sig.graph-overview/1`)** — the four 08a overviews per licence compartment under `web/graph/<ov>/`: O0 `types` (every label kind, gaps included, plus kind→kind edges), O1 `supply` (buyer→vendor through the ONE procurement-relevance rule, D-K2-5/H-13, plus collapsed manufacturer-site groups), O3 `funding` (funder→recipient on grants), O4 `operators` (operator→admin-1 place; `published_by` is provenance, never an operator edge — NEW-2/H-12). Columnar per K2 §6.3 — a `dict` vocabulary plus parallel node/edge arrays with positions precomputed by the deterministic banded layout (closed-form, no PRNG, no `igraph`). Plus `web/graph/index.json` (`sig.graph-index/1`), the per-compartment static `overview.<comp>.svg`, and the `nodes.`/`edges.<comp>.csv` downloads — the CSV is the full-fidelity edge form (H-2 fields + supporting claim ids, SIG-EXPORT-015); both resources are registered in the column registry (`graph_nodes`/`graph_edges`, SIG-TRANSP-016).
- **The caps, held loudly** — a hub's degree-1 literal counterparties past `COLLAPSE_MIN` fold into a labelled group node ("N other suppliers"); an overview still over the 3,000-node cap refuses the build, never a smoothed cut (SIG-UI-118). `sharing_partner_degree` raises rather than mints (SIG-UI-117 — degree-only is never an edge). A withheld or review-pending entity is never a node and an edge that would name one drops whole; a literal party that fails the person screen drops its edge the same way (A-10/SIG-UI-080, Part VIII). Historical and undated edges carry the muted class + the word (H-3/SIG-UI-116).
- **`/graphs/` T1 pages** — the hub (`/graphs/`), `/graphs/<ov>/` with the precomputed SVG + the paginated adjacency table (`…/page/<n>/`, ≤100 rows) carrying every H-2 field with JS off, the per-place `…/<country>/<subdivision>/` drill-downs (K2 C-10) and the `/graph/<ov>/<file>` download endpoints (emitted bytes verbatim in export mode; fixtures derive the same shapes — no named download is a dead link, K13 R-6). Registered in the page-type registry (`/graphs/**` → T1, `sig.graph-overview/1`); zero new script, one `<h1>` per page, `withBase` throughout.
- **Copy batch-21** — the surface's drafted sentences are `GO-*` `pending` rows bound by `data-copy` (B-2); nav gain "Overview graphs" under Explore.

No production mutations; O2/O5/O7 + the components index are GX-08b — P37.25's row, never this one. Requirement ids stamped: **SIG-EXPORT-015**, **SIG-UI-117**, **SIG-UI-118** (owned); cited: SIG-EXPORT-014.
